species.real: The adder is the only snake in Scotland, and there are no snakes in Ireland at all, though that is down to the Ice Age rather than St Patrick.
species.name: Zigzlet

dex.text: Winds through the long grass in a line that makes no sense to anyone. Usually makes perfect sense to the mice.
dex.fact: Adders are Britain's only venomous snake, and although bites are very rarely serious, anyone bitten should go to hospital.

species.real: Male adders 'dance' in spring, rearing up and twisting round each other to shove a rival to the ground. It looks romantic and is in fact a fight.
species.name: Adderking

dex.text: A basking monarch with a cross on its back and a grudge in its heart. Gives way to nobody, except perhaps the sun.
dex.fact: Adders bask in the sun to warm up before hunting, and they hibernate through the winter.
